explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 102 named tracks and releases across current Juno techno, minimal/tech-house and adjacent deep-house bestseller and new-release windows, catalogue represses, current label paths and the full canonical boundary map. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: All required canonical, discussion, revisit, history, map and publication state passed pre-audit; no REPAIR is actionable.

Runs 284–286 failed before Spotify lookup because two placement URI values and one mix-suffixed neighbour name were invalid; this new immutable request corrects every adjacency against the current ledger under a new runId and preserves the same fresh scan.
Every canonical, previously evaluated, PARKED, placement-specific REJECT, preserved alternate, unresolved identity and repository-wide utility identity was excluded.
Nine leads come from nine releases; no release supplies more than one lead.
Planned boundaries avoid those evaluated in the previous five completed discovery runs.
Release prose and genre tags are attributed rather than measured; exact identity and musical dimensions require resolver or lawful evidence.
Neither listener-protected internal handoff is split.
